title: Elementary Certified Facts for the Fermat Quintic Fourfold V(F5) in P^5: the Euler Identity, an Euler Defect, and the Isolated Integer Critical Point of the Affine Cone
description: Lean 4 (core only, v4.22.0) formalization of elementary integer facts about F5 = sum x_i^5: Euler's identity 5F5 = sum x_i dF5/dx_i, the Euler defect -5 prod x_i of G = F5 - 5 prod x_i, and that the only integer point where all partials 5x_i^4 vanish is the origin. Also records the arithmetic constants 126-6=120 and 1751 and string labels; no cohomology, Hodge numbers or cycles are constructed. 10 theorems, no sorry, standard axioms only. The attached paper states exactly these results.
